title: Zones
description: REOSERV data/pub/zones.json — zone definitions and per-map assignments. See src/utils/load_zone_file.rs.

zones.description: Every zone the world knows about. Zone 0 is conventionally the wilderness/default.

zone_id.description: Unique zone identifier. References map_assignments values + reputation_tiers.json zones keys.

name.description: Human-readable zone name shown in-game and in admin tools.

map_assignments.description: Map ID (as a string key) -> zone_id. Maps absent here default to zone 0.
